summary.text: A 7-year-old girl with a history of recurrent ileocolic intussusception had two prior episodes confirmed by ultrasound, the first resolving with air enema and the second spontaneously, with no lead point identified. On her third presentation with bilious emesis and abdominal pain, ultrasound confirmed ileocolic intussusception, reduced with a water-soluble contrast enema, and she was discharged.

She returned the next day with recurrent symptoms and diarrhea; CT revealed cystic pneumatosis coli involving the ascending colon, hepatic flexure and proximal to mid transverse colon with a largest cyst of 3.6 cm, which retrospective review showed was present on her initial CT. Celiac disease and lymphoma were ruled out and imaging showed no lymphadenopathy or pulmonary disease.

She received 2 days of bowel rest, 24 days on a sorbitol-free diet, 26 days of metronidazole (initially IV, then oral) and low-flow oxygen at 2 L/min by nasal cannula; cyst size decreased only slightly and repeat CT showed persistent PCC. Hyperbaric oxygen therapy of 10 daily 90-min sessions at 45 FSW followed, after bilateral tympanostomy tubes, and was tolerated without side effects.

Serial CT scans showed significant reduction in cyst size after HBO initiation with rapid complete resolution of PCC; she remained asymptomatic without intussusception recurrence during admission, was discharged once imaging showed cyst reduction (treatment duration guided by imaging and shared decision-making with the family), and metronidazole and the diet were discontinued. A CT 6 months after completion of treatment showed resolution (the Figure 1 caption instead says 6 months after admission).

In the 8 months after discharge she had three isolated episodes of abdominal pain with CT, ultrasound, EGD and colonoscopy showing no evidence of PCC; the pain was attributed to constipation and disorder of gut-brain interaction and improved with constipation treatment.

Figure 1 caption gives CT scans at 10 months before admission, the day of admission, day 10 of treatment with metronidazole and supplemental oxygen, day 28 of treatment after 4 days of HBO, and resolution of PCC.
